name: opendesign
description: OpenDesign design-canvas tools (10 od_* tools over stdio). Requires the OD daemon at OD_DAEMON_URL (default http://127.0.0.1:7456). NOTE: the MCP server starts and lists tools even when the OD daemon is absent — actual design operations fail until the daemon is installed (flagged host leftover; no Docker on this box).

config_schema.label: OD API Token
config_schema.description: Optional bearer token for non-loopback installs. Secret-bearing: pass a __KMS_REF__<handle>__ marker minted via kms_request + bound via kms_attach — NEVER plaintext.
